record.paper_title: The Flow Associated to Weakly Differentiable Vector Fields: Recent Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Local Lipschitz regularity from differentiability in measure
record.original_question: In the Sobolev setting for weakly differentiable vector fields, can the differentiability-in-measure estimate for the associated regular Lagrangian flow be strengthened to yield some measure-theoretic form of local Lipschitz regularity of the flow?

evidence.quote: Can we infer from (9), as it happens for approximate differentiability, some kind of 'local Lipschitz' regularity of the flow?

This result shows that, at least in the W^{1,p} case, with p > 1, 'local' Lipschitz regularity of the flow holds. Here 'local' should not be understood in the topological sense but, rather, in the measure-theoretic sense.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setting. Let $b:[0,T]\times \mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^d$ be a Borel vector field belonging to $L^1_t(W^{1,p}_{x,\mathrm{loc}})$ with $p>1$, satisfying suitable global growth and bounded-divergence conditions ensuring existence and uniqueness of a regular Lagrangian flow. Recall that a regular Lagrangian flow associated to $b$ is a Borel map $X:[0,T]\times\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^d$ such that:
(i) for $\mathcal{L}^d$-a.e.\ $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$, the curve $t\mapsto X(t,x)$ is an absolutely continuous integral solution of $\dot X(t,x)=b(t,X(t,x))$ with $X(0,x)=x$;
(ii) there exists a constant $L\ge 0$ such that $X(t,\cdot)_\#\mathcal{L}^d\le L\,\mathcal{L}^d$ for every $t\in[0,T]$.

Known fact (differentiability in measure). For such flows there exists a Borel map $W:[0,T]\times\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$ such that, for every $t\in[0,T]$,
$$\frac{X(t,x+h)-X(t,x)-W(t,x)h}{|h|}\xrightarrow[h\to 0]{}0\quad\text{in measure on bounded sets}, \tag{$\ast$}$$
i.e.\ the flow is differentiable in measure in the sense of Ambrosio–Malý.

Question. Can the differentiability-in-measure property $(\ast)$ be strengthened to a measure-theoretic local Lipschitz regularity statement for $X(t,\cdot)$? Precisely: does there exist, for every $\varepsilon>0$ and every bounded set $B\subset\mathbb{R}^d$, a Borel set $E_\varepsilon\subset B$ and a constant $L_\varepsilon$ such that $\mathcal{L}^d(B\setminus E_\varepsilon)<\varepsilon$ and, for $\mathcal{L}^d$-a.e.\ $x\in E_\varepsilon$, there is a measurable neighborhood (in the density / measure-theoretic sense) of $x$ on which $X(t,\cdot)$ admits a Lipschitz representative with Lipschitz constant $\le L_\varepsilon$? More generally, formulate and prove a version of "local Lipschitz" regularity—understood in a measure-theoretic rather than topological sense—that follows from $(\ast)$ in the $W^{1,p}$ Sobolev setting with $p>1$.
artifact.category_tag: Regular Lagrangian flows of weakly differentiable vector fields
artifact.status_search_result: For Sobolev vector fields in $W^{1,p}$ with $p>1$, Crippa–De Lellis established a quantitative Lusin–Lipschitz estimate: outside a set of arbitrarily small measure $\varepsilon$, the regular Lagrangian flow coincides with a Lipschitz map (with constant $\sim e^{C/\varepsilon}$). This provides a measure-theoretic local Lipschitz regularity in the $W^{1,p}$, $p>1$ case, addressing the question affirmatively in that regime. The deeper question of strengthening differentiability-in-measure to local Lipschitz regularity in more general weakly differentiable settings (e.g. $W^{1,1}$ or BV) remains open; differentiability in measure has more recently been established for nearly incompressible BV fields, but a corresponding measure-theoretic Lipschitz regularity is not known.

status_evidence.title: Lipschitz regularity and approximate differentiability of the DiPerna-Lions flow
status_evidence.snippet: Crippa–De Lellis: quantitative Lusin–Lipschitz estimate for the flow of W^{1,p} (p>1) vector fields with bounded divergence.
status_evidence.claim: Measure-theoretic Lusin–Lipschitz regularity is known in the W^{1,p}, p>1, Sobolev case.

status_evidence.title: Differentiability in Measure of the Flow Associated with a Nearly Incompressible BV Vector Field
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes differentiability in measure of the regular Lagrangian flow for nearly incompressible BV vector fields.
status_evidence.claim: Differentiability in measure has been extended beyond Sobolev, but corresponding Lipschitz-type measure regularity is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Quantitative Estimates for Regular Lagrangian Flows with BV Vector Fields
status_evidence.snippet: Quantitative estimates for flows of BV vector fields.
status_evidence.claim: Quantitative regularity in BV is partial; the strengthening to measure-theoretic local Lipschitz is not fully resolved.
